name: fl_pi_llm_js
description: The JavaScript half of fl_pi_llm: pi-agent-core and pi-ai over a Web platform layer, bundled into one script the Rust runtime embeds.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.js --target=browser --format=esm --minify --outfile=../rust/js/fl_pi_llm.js --metafile=meta.json && node notices.mjs meta.json
